name: Harvey T. Halleck
role: Cattle investor from Washington, Pa., later of Mandan
bio: Harvey T. Halleck of Washington, Pennsylvania, spent several days in Medora in June 1884 arranging to put cattle on Tepee bottom. By 1886 he lived at Mandan in Morton County, and in May and June that year the paper printed a notice listing him as a partner in the LeMoyne Cattle Co., Limited.
